scope: Offline prerequisite review only. No RPC, --run, credential-file access, production edits or process-control operations. Only this review record was authored.

pass1ExecutedChecks.initialResult: exit 1: ASCII hex-text digest did not match the raw-calldata-byte telemetry digest

pass1ExecutedChecks.check: Independent local frozen encoder and Ready digest calculation
Executed the exact measured-loop source in memory with mock rpc/canonical functions and a byte-hash mismatch on the first B response
pass1ExecutedChecks.result: Confirmed missing immediate integrity abort: four payload attempts and both canonical checks still ran; capabilityPass=false; no exception
pass1ExecutedChecks.reviewHarnessNote: Initial isolated test omitted its payload argument and failed with ReferenceError; corrected test passed and demonstrated the reported behavior. This was not a production finding.

resolvedDuringReview: Author corrected calldata hashing to sha(Buffer.from(data.slice(2), 'hex')); the corrected --check passed. No reviewer edit to probe or brief.
Pass2: probe reads only injected MAINNET_RPC_URL in --run. Credential-file extraction is isolated to the explicitly authorized trusted launcher, which was reviewed but never executed by the reviewer.
Pass2: byte-hash equality is asserted immediately after retaining each completed attempt; a mismatch throws before the next request.

findings.finding: The run branch reads a hardcoded .env file and ignores an externally injected MAINNET_RPC_URL. This violates the declared endpoint-injection boundary and the carried no-.env scope. Offline --check does not enter this branch, so no credential file was read by the reviewer.
findings.minimalFix: Inside --run only, obtain const endpoint = process.env.MAINNET_RPC_URL ?? ''; assert presence with a fixed nonsecret message; retain the pinned endpoint hash and HTTPS assertions. Remove the .env-reading loop.

findings.finding: Byte parity is only evaluated after all four payload reads and the postcheck. A mismatching reply is not an integrity exception: further reads proceed and failure stays null. This does not meet the brief's abort-on-integrity-mismatch requirement.
findings.minimalFix: After recording each returned row, compare its decoded rawSha256 with the first A row and throw/assert on mismatch before any next request. Preserve the mismatching row and the existing finally destroy/drain/write-once report. Identical decoded JSON already entails parsed result parity. Add an offline check that a first-B mismatch stops subsequent reads.

otherwiseConfirmed: Fixed single payload/id and EIP-1898 source hash with requireCanonical=true; A omits Accept-Encoding and B requests gzip; same source and request bytes in all four payload trials.

Normal successful path issues two precheck methods, four payload methods and two postcheck methods: eight logical reads in six sequential HTTP envelopes. No retry, warmup or fallback loop; Agent maxSockets=1.
Declaration uses exclusive creation before the first RPC; both declaration and result paths are write-once and prior evidence prevents rerun.

Canonical checks validate chain 1, historical block hash and state root before/after. Responses require status 200, expected batch cardinality and unique matching IDs with result present and no RPC error.

Only identity/gzip decoding accepted; compressed and decoded payloads are bounded to 64 MiB. Request timers are 30 seconds, timeout destroys incomplete transport, agent is destroyed on every terminal path, and tracked sockets have a five-second closure check. Incomplete drain sets nonzero exit and allSocketsClosed=false.
Reported transport errors are generic; endpoint is not included in declared/request/result telemetry. Endpoint hash, payload/runner/brief hashes and response hashes are recorded.

Provider refusal to gzip is negative capability evidence, not permission to retry or claim a timing result. Final acceptance must require successful canonical checks, byte parity, gzip on both B replies and successful physical drain; capabilityPass alone cannot waive allSocketsClosed=false or nonzero exit.

exactLoopMockChecks.method: Transpiled and executed the exact current try/catch/finally block in memory with mock RPC/canonical/agent/file/console/process objects. No real socket, process control, evidence output or credential read.

pass2ExecutedChecks.launcherReview: Launcher selects only MAINNET_RPC_URL from the explicitly authorized credential file, does not source its contents or print the endpoint, verifies its hash, passes it via a restricted child environment rather than argv, launches only this probe with --run, and has no retry/relaunch path. Its 200-second outer timeout is a safety ceiling, not additional per-request budget. Missing terminal evidence after interruption cannot pass capability validation or authorize an automatic retry.

approvalBoundary: One declared ABBA capability/byte-parity probe only: eight logical reads in at most six normal-path HTTP envelopes, 30-second request timers, no warmup/retry/fallback. Main operates the launcher; reviewer has not run it. Require byte parity, gzip on both B responses, successful canonical pre/post checks, successful drain and no failure. No timing-win, Solver, repeated-prefix, live or production-change acceptance.
limits: No real HTTP or socket lifecycle test was executed. The mock verifies entry into cleanup/report handling, not physical socket closure. Provider capability and real drain remain measured-run prerequisites.

independentEvidenceReview.ranGate: Read-only inline Node assertions: result-to-declaration hash, reviewed runner/brief/calldata identities, fixed source/hash/root, ABBA order, eight calls/no failure, decoded JSON and per-result hash parity, pre/post header-result hash parity and chain-ID-1 digest, gzip on both B replies, request budgets and terminal socket-closure flag.
independentEvidenceReview.sourceEvidence: Reviewed producer checked chain 1 and the declared block hash/state root before and after. Pre/post decoded-body and header-result hashes match; the chain-ID result digest independently matches JSON-encoded 0x1. This reviewer did not freshly query canonical state or recover omitted raw header values.
independentEvidenceReview.interpretation: Provider honored gzip on both B replies and transmitted about 89.7 percent fewer response-body bytes for identical decoded JSON/result. Counters exclude HTTP/TLS framing. The four observations support this transport capability mechanism only: differing header/body times, two observations per arm, and the probe's own synchronous decoder are not production streaming, Solver or live latency validation.

pendingReviewRequirements: Actual streaming decoder and StringDecoder preserve single/batch JSON and fragmented Unicode; decoded-byte telemetry remains distinct from encoded response-body bytes and string-unit limits.

Signal and failure cleanup cover HTTP and decoder lifetimes, settle/emit timing once, and never destroy a socket already reused after response.complete. The late-abort test must exercise real local socket reuse rather than just a mocked completion flag.

Valid compressed non-2xx and RPC error bodies retain their original status/error semantics; malformed or unsupported encodings fail without exposing raw body/endpoint or adding retry/fallback behavior.
Identity response remains valid when gzip negotiation is ignored; malformed/truncated gzip, overflow/decoder failure and abort cannot become successful or partial JSON results.

Execute new local transport tests plus existing deadline and pinned-backend regressions. Freeze/review the two-file delta before any later bounded performance diagnostic; no Family, Solver, scheduler, Rust, dependency or policy changes.
productionDesignReview.acceptanceBoundary: Brief is suitable for implementation review, not implementation approval. Capability evidence does not establish production socket safety or a speedup. A later separately predeclared same-input comparison must retain original amounts, outputs, canonical checks, calls, deadlines, cancellations and drains.
